title: Maiora 102 Stamos Bien: Luxury 102ft Motor Yacht
description: 2001 Maiora 102 Stamos Bien — 102ft, 4‑cabin Miami yacht with sculpted lines and large privacy glazing for sea views.
html:
Built in 2001, Stamos Bien is a Maiora 102 motor yacht measuring 102 ft (31.09 m) overall and configured as a power yacht with a four-cabin guest plan; her Miami homeport makes her immediately available for sun-trailing cruises in Florida waters. The model’s proportions create generous deck volumes and interior ceiling heights, and the vessel’s profile is instantly recognizable — an intentional statement that combines functional deck flow with a refined, architectural silhouette.

Distinctive Exterior Lines and Permeable Windows

The exterior is defined by sweeping, sculpted surfaces and large windows finished in an obscuring material that nevertheless delivers substantial visibility and daylight to the interior. From the aft deck through to the salon and bar area, sightlines to the sea are prioritized, so entertaining spaces feel connected to the horizon. The arrangement supports relaxed aft-deck dining and flybridge lounging while maintaining sleek, contemporary lines on the hull and superstructure.

Interior Flow: Salon, Bar and Four Comfortable Cabins

Inside, the salon is laid out to maximize those panoramic views — furniture placement and sightlines are arranged so the bar becomes both a social focal point and a vantage for watching the passing seascape. The yacht’s four-cabin plan provides private accommodations for owners and guests, each designed for comfort and practical storage. The layout supports a smooth transition between salon, dining, and guest areas, making day-to-day life aboard straightforward whether hosting a weekend group or cruising with family.

Performance, Systems and Modern Navigation Upgrades

Stamos Bien is performance-oriented without being extreme, with a reported top speed of 24 knots and systems sized to support extended cruising and liveaboard use. The mechanical and electrical installations are laid out for accessibility, and the yacht has received navigation and electronics upgrades to bring bridge systems in line with contemporary expectations — improving situational awareness and route planning while underway. Routine maintenance and clear systems organization contribute to reliable operation and comfortable underway performance.

Specifications: Length, Draft, Speed and Miami Homeport

Key particulars for Stamos Bien include an overall length of 102 ft (31.09 m), a model year of 2001, and a four-cabin accommodation plan; her maximum speed is listed at 24 knots. Draft is not disclosed in the current listing (N/A), and she is currently located in Miami, FL, offering easy access to Florida cruising grounds and international connections via nearby marinas and airports.

Stamos Bien Recap: Key Features and Learn More Options

Stamos Bien stands out for its personal, well-recognizable exterior design, expansive glazing that creates permeability between interior and exterior, an inviting salon with bar seating, and comfortable four-cabin accommodations — all on a 102 ft Maiora hull that reaches up to 24 knots. For owners seeking a yacht with architectural presence, practical guest spaces, and updated navigation systems, she represents a compelling option in the Miami market.
